title: I'm pleased with how small this is - it fits nicely ...
text: I'm pleased with how small this is - it fits nicely .... I'm pleased with how small this is - it fits nicely on my bedside table. It's a bit louder than I expected, though (even on the low setting), and something I'm ultimately not running at night while we sleep. I do leave it on during the day, though, to clear out the room from any allergens we bring in through the day. We don't have an issue with odors in our bedroom, so I can't comment as to whether it removes bad smells, but I have noticed the air becomes a bit stale when I have it on - kind of like airplane air. We've been using it for a few months, and the filter and unit seem just fine (not clogged/messy, etc). Although some have suggested leaving it to run continuously, I'm not interested in leaving it totally unattended, or on for several hours at a time. We use for about 10 hours at a time, and it seems ok.
